description: R1-frontier: GPT-6 Astra on the R1 balanced_03 panel (50 mazes), the R1 fixed cell verbatim (minimal/image_only/text_summary_and_last3+stateless/zero_shot/egocentric, step_by_step, progress_stall_k=30). Separate experimental set from core R1. Thinking ON (reasoning_effort=xhigh, mirroring Claude R1's effort=xhigh) with the R1 64k output cap. Flex tier = Batch-API pricing on synchronous calls, so the plain (non-lockstep) worker is used.
_note_no_conditions: No conditions key => single (default) cell built from experiment_config overlay. Do NOT add conditions (that would re-enable the sweep).
_note_model_params: OpenAI reasoning models reject temperature/top_p, so none is sent (the temperature key is absent on purpose). max_tokens is sent as max_completion_tokens and covers reasoning + visible output, matching the Claude/Kimi R1 64k cap. image_detail=high so the maze render is not downscaled to the 512px low-detail tile. service_tier=flex bills at Batch rates ($5 in / $0.50 cached / $25 out per 1M for gpt-6-astra, developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing 2026-09-12); flex capacity misses return 429 (not billed) and are retried with backoff — max_attempts=30 rides out a flex/TPM storm instead of ending the episode as agent_error. spend_cap_usd is a per-worker-process hard stop (reset on restart) — pair it with an OpenAI project budget limit. Calibration (2026-09-12): the one-maze Astra probe measured 295 mean output tokens/query, projecting the panel at $16-34 flex across the calibration/Opus-R1/Kimi-R1 queries-per-episode scenarios; the $100 cap is ~3x the top scenario to absorb harder mazes thinking longer. OpenAI reserves max_completion_tokens against the TPM limit at request time, so API_WORKER_CONCURRENCY must fit the key's usage tier (see scripts/estimate_frontier_cost.py output).
